name: Chull

features.Beast of Burden: The chull’s carrying capacity is 1,500 lbs
features.Plodding Pace: The chull can only use the Move action once per turn.

Strike: Pincer.Description: Attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) keen damage.

Defense Curl.Description: The chull retracts their head and legs to defend themself until the start of their next turn. While retracted, the chull’s deflect value increases to 6 and they can use the Brace action as if they were in cover. At the start of each of their turns, the chull can spend 1 focus to maintain this effect for an additional round.

Tactics: Immensely docile, a chull almost always retreats into their shell with their Defense Curl during combat. However, once pushed to the brink, they use their large claws to defend themselves; a pinch from a chull hurts.
